title: UAAP: FEU women end campaign on winning note, outlast La Salle
summary: Far Eastern University wrapped up its UAAP Season 89 women's basketball campaign on a winning note, battling back to defeat De La Salle University, 65-63, on Saturday at the Araneta Coliseum.
